instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act)
was: Not listed in Annex III; high-risk only under Art. 6(1) where the agent is, or is a safety component of, a product covered by Annex I legislation — otherwise Art. 4 (AI literacy), Art. 5 (prohibited practices) and Art. 50 (transparency) apply (Annex III §2 covers critical digital infrastructure, road traffic and water, gas, heating or electricity supply, not food systems)
now: Not listed in Annex III; high-risk only under Art. 6(1) where the agent is, or is a safety component of, a product covered by Annex I legislation and that product must undergo third-party conformity assessment under that legislation — otherwise Art. 4 (AI literacy) and Art. 5 (prohibited practices) apply, and Art. 50 (transparency) where the agent interacts with people or generates synthetic content (Annex III §2 covers critical digital infrastructure, road traffic and water, gas, heating or electricity supply, not food systems)
sourceTitle: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), Official Journal text (Publications Office); amendments checked in Regulation (EU) 2026/1744
note: Art. 6(1) needs both conditions: (a) safety component of, or itself, a product under Annex I legislation and (b) that product must undergo third-party conformity assessment. Art. 50 applies only to systems that interact with people or generate or manipulate content, so it was made conditional. Annex III point 2 reads: safety components in the management and operation of critical digital infrastructure, road traffic, or in the supply of water, gas, heating or electricity.

sourceTitle: Regulation (EU) 2025/2650 amending Regulation (EU) 2023/1115, Official Journal text (Publications Office)
note: Citation unchanged; question reworded. The amendment requires all operators (not only primary ones) to submit due diligence statements, micro or small primary operators a one-time simplified declaration (Art. 4a), and only the first downstream operator or trader to collect and keep the reference numbers or declaration identifiers. Operators keep statements five years; downstream operators and traders keep supplier and recipient information at least five years. The question said 'primary operators submit' and 'downstream operators and traders collect'.
